description: Phase 0 minimal capability set for the main window: only Tauri's safe core defaults (window/app/event/resource basics needed for the webview to function and for app-defined #[tauri::command] functions such as get_app_info to be invoked). No dialog, filesystem, shell, or sidecar-execute permissions are granted yet. See src-tauri/binaries/README.md and engine-src/README.md: a scoped shell:allow-execute permission for the named pgn-extract sidecar (architecture.md §16.3) must be added in Phase 1, together with narrowly-scoped app-config/app-cache filesystem access and the dialog permissions the Files screen needs - never broad shell or filesystem access.
